final: WITH album_counts AS (SELECT ArtistId, COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId), total AS (SELECT SUM(album_count) AS album_total FROM album_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.ArtistId, c.album_count, 1.0 * c.album_count / t.album_total AS share FROM album_counts AS c JOIN total AS t ON t.album_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.ArtistId, s.album_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS difference FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
